intro_text: The patrol catches the scent of infection as they near the o_c_n border.

success_outcomes.text: When they near the border, they find a patrol of o_c_n cats crouched over an infected squirrel. p_l warns the o_c_n cats not to touch it, and they take {PRONOUN/p_l/poss} advice, standing up and leaving the prey with a respectful nod to the c_n patrol.

When they reach the source of the scent, the patrol finds a couple of o_c_n cats on their side of the border, burying an infected piece of prey. They warn the patrol to check the eyes of their prey before they eat it. Something unfortunate must have happened.

fail_outcomes.text: The patrol finds a couple of o_c_n cats burying some infected prey at the border. p_l warns them to bury their dangerous prey away from c_n territory next time, and the o_c_n cats leave, tails twitching.
The patrol wanders for a moment, trying to pinpoint the scent, but the wind carries it away before it can be found.
The patrol approaches the border just as a small o_c_n patrol is leaving. On the border line lays a dead, infected mouse. What is that supposed to mean?

intro_text: The patrol goes to negotiate a formal truce with o_c_n to support them in the spread of the infection, as both Clans are suffering heavy losses.
decline_text: The patrol decides to turn around. They don't need o_c_n's support!

success_outcomes.text: They meet the o_c_n patrol at the border, both sides exchanging polite nods. o_c_n hands a freshly caught rabbit to the patrol, while r_c passes them a bundle of herbs. The two groups part ways after a respectful, yet sombre, conversation.
The o_c_n patrol arrives, looking exhausted, but healthy. The groups exchange pleasantries, sharing small amounts of prey and herbs, before parting ways.

fail_outcomes.text: When the o_c_n patrol gets to the border, it's unmistakeable that one of their cats is infected. The patrol turns away, scolding o_c_n for being so careless.

Before the o_c_n patrol can even get to the border, p_l announces that they smell an infected cat. Is o_c_n sending infected cats to their truce meeting? The patrol turns around right away, making sure to muddy up the border marker as a sign of their disdain.

The o_c_n patrol is already at the border when the patrol arrives. When they get close, p_l and r_c exchange uncertain glances about one of the other patrol members-- it seems o_c_n has brought an infected cat to the border meeting. Just before p_l can propose parting ways early, the infected cat lunges over the border, reaching for r_c with unsheathed claws. p_l manages to pull {PRONOUN/r_c/object} out of the way, and the rest of o_c_n's patrol is apologetic, but the damage has been done.

The patrol gets to the border at the arranged meeting time, but after waiting for several hours, the o_c_n patrol never shows up. p_l remarks that they hope nothing too terrible happened to stop them from showing up, and they head back home.
